team.desc: Our consultants bring deep expertise in both Singapore and Vietnam markets — championing bilateral trade and business growth.
team.jinghaoBioShort: PhD in Finance, cross-border investment strategist, and AI & analytics advisor bridging Singapore and Vietnam capital markets.
team.jinghaoBioFull:
Dr Jinghao Ke is a Singapore-based finance and business strategy leader who bridges Vietnam and Singapore markets through structured investment facilitation, market entry consulting, and cross-border business development. As CEO of SVBB, he leverages over 15 years of corporate finance expertise, regional networks, and AI-powered analytics to help Singapore enterprises navigate Vietnam's investment landscape and to support Vietnamese project sponsors in accessing Singapore capital markets.

He specialises in structuring bilateral investment opportunities between Singapore and Vietnam, working with family offices, corporate sponsors, and institutional investors across ASEAN. His mandate-based engagement model supports investors seeking vetted Vietnam deal flow, and Vietnamese project sponsors requiring strategic positioning for Singapore and regional capital partners. Through SVBB's ecosystem partnerships — including VietCham Singapore, Hanoisme, and networks spanning government agencies, banks, and industry associations — he delivers grounded market intelligence and curated introductions.

Dr Ke holds a PhD in Corporate Finance from Singapore Management University, where his research examined CEO incentives, corporate governance, and firm valuation. He has trained over 1,000 professionals across Singapore and ASEAN in corporate finance, financial modelling, machine learning for investment analysis, and data-driven decision frameworks.

As CEO at Metaskills Institute, he designs and delivers AI and analytics training for enterprise and government clients including UOB, Maybank, OCBC Bank, Great Eastern, and Changi General Hospital. He also serves as Adjunct Faculty at Singapore Management University (since 2016), with affiliate appointments at NUS Asian Institute of Digital Finance, AI Singapore, HKU SPACE, and NTUC LearningHub. His prior role as Chief Investment Officer at JCube Capital Partners, managing a MAS-licensed AI-augmented investment fund, reflects his commitment to translating analytical rigour into commercial outcomes for investors and project sponsors across Singapore and Vietnam.
team.philongTitle: VP & Co-Founder, Singapore Vietnam Chambers of Commerce; CBDO, SVBB
team.philongBioShort: Technology and business leader helping SMEs and startups scale across Singapore and Vietnam, with deep experience in IT service management and AI-driven digitalisation.
team.philongBioFull:
Phi Long is a technology and business leader specialising in helping SMEs and startups scale across Singapore and Vietnam. He bridges technology, operations, and cross-border business strategy, making him a key enabler of SVBB's mission to connect and grow Singapore–Vietnam enterprises.

As Vice President and co-founder of the Singapore Vietnam Chambers of Commerce, Phi Long plays a central role in strengthening trade and investment flows between the two countries. He has supported more than 100 Vietnamese companies in market entry, partnership building, and regional growth. He also serves as President of the Vietnamese Association in Singapore and Vice-President of the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce in Singapore. As Director of Regulus Investment and Capital Holdings, he contributes to capital allocation and advisory for technology-driven and high-growth ventures.

As Managing Director of Way4SME Pte Ltd, Phi Long acts as a trusted IT and digital transformation partner to Singapore SMEs, helping them professionalise IT operations and modernise their technology stack. At VASSS Pte Ltd, he oversees the delivery of value-added software, systems, and solutions tailored to SME needs.

In recent years, Phi Long has developed strong capabilities in Generative AI and agentic technology stacks, applying these tools to automate workflows, enhance customer service, and create intelligent business systems. He also serves as Chief Technology Officer of Metaskills Institute, guiding AI and digital platforms for workforce training and capability development.

Phi Long holds professional certifications including PMP, ITIL Expert, and CEH. He holds a degree in Computer Engineering from Nanyang Technological University and also studied at Ho Chi Minh University of Banking with a specialisation in stock exchange and financial markets. With over 15 years of trading experience across equities, futures, options, and cryptocurrencies in Vietnam, Singapore, and the United States, he brings a practitioner's understanding of risk, market structure, and financial innovation.
team.chrisBioShort: Chief Strategist helping Singapore companies design and execute market entry and expansion into Vietnam, blending cross-border strategy with AI-enabled growth.
team.chrisBioFull:
Chris Tan is the Chief Strategist and Consultant at SVBB, where he helps Singapore-based companies design and execute successful market entry and expansion strategies into Vietnam. He specialises in aligning strategy, partnerships, and execution so that companies can navigate Vietnam's fast-evolving business landscape with clarity and confidence.

At SVBB, Chris partners with founders, C-suite leaders, and senior executives to structure practical, risk-aware pathways into Vietnam. He advises on market entry strategy, partner identification and due diligence, go-to-market design, and on-the-ground execution support. He created and leads the Business Vietnam Programme, originally developed in collaboration with a leading Singapore university, which has brought more than 500 business owners, investors, and senior executives into Vietnam to explore opportunities, partnerships, and expansion strategies.

Chris brings together deep experience in international business development and AI-enabled transformation. His work spans Agentic AI, data science, AI-driven marketing, and algorithmic trading, enabling companies to use data and automation to de-risk expansion, sharpen positioning, and accelerate revenue growth in Vietnam and the wider region.

Before SVBB, Chris held senior leadership roles across higher education, government, and technology ventures. He was a founding team member of a professional training institute at a top Singapore university, growing it into one of the university's top-performing revenue units with over 100 programmes and multi-million-dollar annual revenues. He has led large-scale capability development initiatives in AI, data analytics, software development, and digital marketing in collaboration with government agencies, industry partners, and multinationals. Earlier in his career, he founded and scaled a software company serving government agencies and multinational firms.

For SVBB clients, Chris is particularly effective in situations where strategy must be translated into execution across multiple stakeholders in both Singapore and Vietnam.
team.mindyTitle: Head of SME Consulting & Partnerships, SVBB
team.mindyBioShort: Founder-CEO who scaled Newstead Technologies into a multi-country IT retail group, now advising SMEs on regional scale-up and Vietnam expansion.
team.mindyBioFull:
Mindy Tan is the Head of SME Consulting & Partnerships at SVBB, where she leads initiatives that help Singapore and regional SMEs expand and scale in Vietnam and across Southeast Asia. She brings to SVBB a rare founder–CEO track record, having built Newstead Technologies from a single outlet into one of Singapore's most recognisable IT retail and distribution groups.

In her broader career, she has led a business with more than 600 employees across 6 Asian countries and annual revenues exceeding US$250 million. Starting from a single store in the late 1990s, Mindy personally drove Newstead's growth by securing prime locations, negotiating distribution rights with leading global technology brands, and reinvesting profits to open new outlets and concepts. Over nearly two decades, she scaled the business into an IT retail behemoth, managing more than 40 outlets at its height under brands such as Newstead, Nübox and Digital Style.

Under her leadership, Newstead's value was built on more than store count: she institutionalised commercial, operational, and HR systems robust enough to support hundreds of employees and hundreds of millions of dollars in annual sales. This "built from zero" experience gives her deep, practical insight into capital discipline, store economics, brand partnerships, and multi-location operations.

At SVBB, Mindy translates these achievements into practical, high-impact advisory work for SMEs, particularly those seeking to expand into Vietnam or to professionalise and scale their businesses beyond founder-centric operations. She works closely with owners and leadership teams on market entry, channel strategy, and operational excellence, helping them apply proven playbooks to build resilient, investor-ready businesses.
team.andrewBioShort: 16-year SAF veteran turned AI operations and training specialist, driving practical AI adoption and workflow design for businesses.
team.andrewBioFull:
Andrew Toh brings a unique combination of military leadership, adult education expertise, and AI-driven business transformation. He served 16 years in the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) as a Subject Matter Expert in signal operations, specialising in LAN/WAN and radio communication systems. During his service, he was deeply involved in adult training and coaching, designing and delivering structured programmes for Regulars, Full-Time National Servicemen, and NSmen across leadership and technical domains.

He specialised in man management, training system design, and trainer development, including matching different training methodologies to different learner profiles, and is highly adaptive in adjusting training delivery dynamically to meet operational needs. He was also actively involved in large-scale national events, including the National Day Parade (NDP) 2009, 2013, and 2018, contributing to planning, coordination, and execution at scale.

After transitioning from the military, Andrew expanded into AI operations, business development, and consulting, specialising in: AI workflow design and implementation; vibe coding and prompt engineering; customised AI courses tailored to company use cases; train-the-trainer programmes for AI literacy and adoption; and business development and operational consulting. He drives practical AI adoption aligned to real-world business needs, helping organisations transition to AI-enabled operations effectively.

businessDev.faq1Q: What types of companies are these packages suitable for?
businessDev.faq1A: These packages are designed for Singapore-registered SMEs looking to enter or expand in Vietnam — whether you're exploring the market for the first time or ready to establish distribution channels.
businessDev.faq2Q: Can SVBB help us find distributors in Vietnam?
businessDev.faq2A: Yes. Distributor, reseller, and agent identification is a core part of our service. We systematically longlist, qualify, and shortlist potential partners based on your sector, product, and commercial requirements.
businessDev.faq3Q: Do you support business matching and local meetings?
businessDev.faq3A: Absolutely. We coordinate introductions, arrange meetings with qualified prospects, and provide bilingual support for discussions and follow-ups.
businessDev.faq4Q: How long does a typical engagement take?
businessDev.faq4A: Most packages run between 2 to 6 months depending on scope. Entry Lite is typically 8–10 weeks, while BD Accelerator and Market Launch Pro run for 6 months.
businessDev.faq5Q: Are these packages suitable for MRA-supported overseas expansion projects?
businessDev.faq5A: Our packages are structured with clear deliverables and timelines that align well with Singapore SME overseas expansion planning frameworks. We can discuss how this applies to your specific situation during a consultation.
businessDev.faq6Q: What happens after the first package ends?
businessDev.faq6A: We can continue with follow-on BD support, partner management, or escalate to a more comprehensive package. Many clients start with Entry Lite and progress to Channel Builder or BD Accelerator.

investors.processTag: How We Work With Investors & Sponsors
investors.step1Desc: We sign a mutual NDA and clarify your objectives — whether you are an investor, a project sponsor, or both — including focus, ticket sizes, sectors, and risk appetite before any opportunity or project details are shared.
investors.step2Desc: We identify relevant opportunities for investors, and help sponsors structure and present projects to match investor expectations, then move to detailed information and site visits when there is genuine interest.
investors.step3Desc: We facilitate initial discussions and coordinate logistics between investors and sponsors, then hand over to your internal team and advisers for detailed due diligence, documentation, and the final investment decision.

mandates.pageDesc: How we work with investors, family offices, and project sponsors — clear written agreements, mutual confidentiality, and success-based compensation.
mandates.intro: We work via clear written agreements that define scope, responsibilities, and compensation. Our work is success-based, meaning our incentives are aligned with closed, value-creating outcomes for our clients.
mandates.capRaiseDesc: For corporate groups and project sponsors, we work under capital-raising mandates that clearly define project scope, target investor profiles, indicative timelines, and success-fee logic. We do not receive or hold client funds; all transactions flow directly between the investor and the sponsor, with us acting as introducer and coordinator. Our role is to help you prepare investor-ready projects and connect you with suitable partners in Singapore and the region.
mandates.s1Desc: We act as an introducer and coordinator — not a discretionary asset manager or fund. The scope of every engagement is documented in a written mandate, and compensation is success-based and tied to defined outcomes.
mandates.s2Desc: We recommend a mutual NDA at the outset. We are comfortable using either your standard NDA or our draft. Information shared with us is used solely for evaluating the relevant opportunities and is not disclosed to third parties without consent.
mandates.s3Desc: Our fees are a percentage of the transaction value and broadly aligned with market practice for introduction and coordination services. Specific tiers, caps, and definitions are disclosed only inside the signed mandate, never on this website.
mandates.s4Desc: We do not provide regulated investment advice. Investors, family offices, and project sponsors rely on their own legal, tax, and financial advisers for due diligence and decision-making. Our role is limited to introductions, coordination, and process support.
mandates.ctaTitle: Request our standard NDA & mandate outline
mandates.ctaDesc: Tell us a little about your investment focus or project, and we will share the relevant documents.
